name: Fight List 2 - Categories Game
summary:
Fight List 2 is a fast-paced quiz and word game developed by Two4Tea. Players compete in real-time matches by answering category-based prompts using words that begin with a randomly chosen letter. The goal is to provide as many valid answers as possible within a time limit to outscore your opponent.

The game includes thousands of categories ranging from general knowledge to pop culture. It features online multiplayer, global leaderboards, performance statistics, in-game chat, and power-ups like jokers to assist players during tough rounds.

Designed for mobile platforms, Fight List 2 builds on the success of the original Fight List by introducing improved visuals, more varied topics, and enhanced matchmaking systems.
